name: 086.7 — the optional arguments the sweep did not reach
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 086.7: the optional arguments of the action verbs go through the house helper, so a wrong type raises naming the verb and the parameter instead of LuaJ's bare "bad argument", a numeric string is refused instead of being coerced and sent, and an explicit nil in a slot the caller passed is refused.
